D.t: Christina Bohannan leads by 9.4 in the forecast and wins 95% of simulations. The cushion is about 32,468 votes; a one point swing is about 1,720 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +2.4 and D +16.5. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
